# Chung-Won Woo (우청원) — Carbon, ESG & Innovation Accounting Research

> Associate Professor of Accounting, Changwon National University, South Korea.
> Empirical research on how carbon regulation (EU CBAM), climate risk, ESG,
> innovation strategy, and information-security investment show up in firms'
> costs, disclosures, audits, and market value. 42 published papers,
> 1,450+ citations, h-index 17. Formerly Research Fellow at the Science and
> Technology Policy Institute (STEPI), Korea's national think tank for S&T policy.

## Papers

Every published paper has a summary page carrying its abstract, full
bibliographic data, and citation formats.


<!-- GEN:LLMS -->
### Carbon, climate & environment

- [Does the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Affect Korean Firms' Stock Prices?](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/cbam-korea-2024.html): Review of Accounting and Policy Studies, 2024.
- [Does Climate Change Exposure Hurt Corporate Financial and Energy Performance?](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/climate-exposure-2024.html): Journal of Cleaner Production, 2024.
- [Do Cost-Squeezed Suppliers Give Up on Green?](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/supplier-cogs-environmental-2024.html): Review of Accounting and Policy Studies, 2024.
- [Does Carbon Risk Increase Audit Hours and Audit Fees?](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/carbon-risk-audit-fees-2023.html): Korea International Accounting Review, 2023.
- [Suppliers' communication capability and external green integration for green and financial performance in Korean construction industry](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/supplier-communication-green-integration-2016.html): Journal of Cleaner Production, 2016.
- [Environmental Capabilities of Suppliers for Green Supply Chain Management in Construction Projects: A Case Study in Korea](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/supplier-environmental-capabilities-gscm-2016.html): Sustainability, 2016.
- [The static and dynamic environmental efficiency of renewable energy: A Malmquist index analysis of OECD countries](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/renewable-energy-environmental-efficiency-2015.html): Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, 2015.
- [Impact of Green Innovation on Labor Productivity and its Determinants: an Analysis of the Korean Manufacturing Industry](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/green-innovation-labor-productivity-2014.html): Business Strategy and the Environment, 2014.
- [Exploring the Impact of Complementary Assets on the Environmental Performance in Manufacturing SMEs](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/complementary-assets-environmental-performance-2014.html): Sustainability, 2014.

- [성과보상차등이 기업 혁신성과에 미치는 영향: 혁신 프로세스 단계별 분석](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/performance-pay-differentiation-innovation-2026.html): 혁신기업연구, 2026.

- [기계학습을 활용한 혁신성과 예측 및 변수 중요도 분석](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/machine-learning-innovation-prediction-2022.html): 경영교육연구, 2022.

- [스마트이동체 기업의 원가효율성 분석: 자율주행차, 드론 기업을 중심으로](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/smart-mobility-cost-efficiency-2021.html): 경영교육연구, 2021.

- [원가관리가 기업내부 연구개발 효율성에 미치는 영향](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/cost-management-rd-efficiency-2016.html): 관리회계연구, 2016.
- [Value capture mechanism: R & D productivity comparison of SMEs](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/value-capture-rd-productivity-2015.html): Management Decision, 2015.
- [Labor Union Effects on Innovation and Commercialization Productivity: An Integrated Propensity Score Matching and Two-Stage Data Envelopment Analysis](https://chungwonwoo.com/papers/labor-union-innovation-productivity-2015.html): Sustainability, 2015.
